disable_screensaver: Stops your PC from sleeping or starting its screensaver while a session runs.
flex_display: Only for virtual displays: resizes the virtual screen to follow the PC window.
force_adb_forward: Uses adb forward instead of adb reverse. Only matters on the adb path.
help: Prints the command-line help and exits. Nothing to change here.
hwdec: Hardware decoding on the PC: auto, or a named API such as d3d11va. Software is a fallback.
ignore_video_encoder_constraints: Ignores the encoder's size limits, so unusual sizes are allowed even when unsupported.
list_camera_sizes: Lists the camera resolutions the tablet offers, then exits.
list_cameras: Lists the tablet's cameras, then exits.
list_displays: Lists the tablet's displays with their ids, then exits.
list_encoders: Lists the tablet's video and audio encoders, then exits. Useful before picking one.
no_audio: Sends no audio at all. The tablet keeps playing its own sound.
no_audio_playback: Captures audio but does not play it on the PC. The tablet's own sound is unaffected.
no_mipmaps: Turns off mipmap generation in the PC renderer, slightly cheaper, slightly softer when scaled.
no_mouse_hover: Stops sending mouse movement without a button held.
no_terminal_title: Stops the terminal title from being rewritten. Irrelevant to the app window.
no_video: Sends no video. Used for audio-only sessions.
no_video_playback: Captures video but shows no window on the PC. Pair with recording.
pause_on_exit: Pauses on exit: true, false, or if_error. About what the terminal does when a session ends.
prefer_text: When the clipboard holds several formats, share plain text rather than rich content.
push_target: Where the server jar is pushed on the tablet. Only matters on the adb path.
require_audio: Fails the session when audio capture cannot start, instead of continuing silently.
select_tcpip: Switches the device to TCP/IP adb and exits.
show_touches: Draws the tablet's touch points on the device screen while mirroring.
stay_awake: Keeps the tablet awake while it is connected to power.
turn_screen_off: Turns the tablet's screen off while mirroring continues. This changes display power state, so it is off by default here.
v4l2_buffer: Buffers used by the Linux v4l2 sink. Not used on Windows.
v4l2_sink: Linux only: writes frames to a v4l2loopback device, which behaves like a camera.
verbosity: Log detail: verbose, debug, info, warn or error.
version: Prints the server version and exits.
audio_bit_rate: Audio bitrate in bits per second. 128000 is a reasonable default for game sound.
audio_buffer: Milliseconds of audio buffered before playback, to absorb jitter. Higher is smoother, later.
audio_codec: Audio codec: opus, aac, flac, raw. All are software-encoded on the tablet and cheap.
audio_codec_options: Extra encoder options, as comma-separated key:type=value pairs.
audio_dup: Plays on the tablet AND captures. Without it the tablet goes silent: locked on here.
audio_encoder: Names a specific audio encoder on the tablet instead of letting it choose.
audio_output_buffer: Milliseconds of audio buffered on the PC's output device.
audio_source: Where audio comes from: playback (app sound, keeps the tablet audible) or output. Locked to playback here.
always_on_top: Keeps this window above all others.
angle: Renderer backend on the PC: opengl, opengles2, opengles, direct3d, metal or software.
background_color: Colour of the PC window behind the video, as #RRGGBB.
capture_orientation: Locks capture rotation: 0, 90, 180, 270, or flip variants.
display_id: Which tablet display to capture. 0 is the built-in panel.
display_ime_policy: Keyboard behaviour on a virtual display: default, hide or require.
display_orientation: Initial orientation for a virtual display.
list_apps: Lists installed apps on the tablet, then exits.
new_display: Creates a second virtual display instead of mirroring the panel. Not what this tool is for.
no_vd_destroy_content: Keeps a virtual display's contents when it is closed.
no_vd_system_decorations: Hides the status and navigation bars on a virtual display.
no_window: Shows no window at all on the PC.
no_window_aspect_ratio_lock: Lets the PC window be resized to any shape instead of keeping the video's aspect.
orientation: Earlier name for capture rotation. Use capture orientation instead.
render_driver: Which graphics API renders the video window on the PC.
render_fit: How video fits the window: fit (whole frame, black bars) or fill (cropped edges).
start_app: Starts an app on the tablet right after connecting.
window_borderless: Window without a title bar or frame.
window_height: Initial PC window height in pixels.
window_title: Text in the PC window's title bar. Streaming tools list windows by this name.
window_width: Initial PC window width in pixels.
gamepad: How gamepads are exposed to the tablet: uhid, hid or disabled.
keep_active: Keeps the tablet from going idle during a session.
keyboard: Keyboard input mode: sdk, uhid or disabled. sdk needs no extra permission.
legacy_paste: Uses the older clipboard paste method, for devices that misbehave with the new one.
mouse: Mouse input mode: sdk, uhid or disabled.
mouse_bind: Mouse buttons mapped to other actions, such as back or home. Format: xxx,bbb=action.
no_clipboard_autosync: Stops the clipboard syncing automatically in either direction.
no_control: Sends no input at all: the PC can watch but not touch the tablet.
no_key_repeat: Stops held keys from repeating on the tablet.
otg: Open Android's USB-on-the-go mode: the PC acts as a keyboard and mouse without adb.
power_off_on_close: Puts the tablet's screen to sleep when the session ends.
raw_key_events: Sends raw key events rather than translated ones, so the tablet sees physical key codes.
screen_off_timeout: Sets the tablet's screen timeout for the session and restores it afterwards.
shortcut_mod: Modifier key used for scrcpy's keyboard shortcuts on the PC, lalt or lsuper.
no_playback: Disables audio playback on the PC. The tablet keeps its own sound.
record: Records the stream to a file on the PC. Off by default; never written to the tablet.
record_format: Container for the recording: mp4 or mkv. mkv survives a crash better.
record_orientation: Rotation applied to the recording: 0, 90, 180 or 270.
kill_adb_on_close: Stops the adb server when the session ends. adb path only.
no_cleanup: Leaves the server process running on the tablet instead of stopping it.
no_power_on: Does not power the tablet's screen on when a session starts.
port: TCP port for the session. Both ends must agree.
print_fps: Periodically logs the measured frame rate.
select_usb: Selects a USB device and exits.
serial: Which connected device to use, by serial. Blank means the only one.
tcpip: Restarts adb on the tablet in TCP/IP mode on the given port.
time_limit: Ends the session automatically after this many seconds.
tunnel_host: Host to tunnel to, for adb forward mode.
tunnel_port: Port to tunnel to, for adb forward mode.
camera_ar: Aspect ratio for camera capture, e.g. 16:9.
camera_facing: Camera to use: front or back.
camera_high_speed: Uses the camera's high-speed capture mode, which supports higher frame rates.
camera_id: Numeric camera id, as listed by the camera list.
camera_size: Capture size for the camera, for example 1920x1080.
camera_torch: Turns the camera torch on or off.
crop: Crops the captured frame, as width:height:x:y. Leave empty for the full screen.
max_fps: Caps the frame rate the tablet encodes. 60 is the target here; the panel keeps its own rate.
max_size: Longest edge of the captured frame. 2560 gives 2560x1708 on a 3:2 panel.
min_size_alignment: Rounds the capture size to a multiple of this, for encoder quirks.
no_downsize_on_error: Stops automatic retry at a lower resolution when the encoder fails.
video_bit_rate: Video bitrate in bits per second. Higher is better quality and a heavier stream.
video_buffer: Milliseconds of video buffered before playback. Higher absorbs jitter, adds delay.
video_codec: Video codec: h264, h265, av1, vp8 or vp9. H.265 is hardware-encoded on this tablet.
video_codec_options: Extra encoder options, as comma-separated key:type=value pairs, e.g. i-frame-interval:2.
video_encoder: Names a specific MediaCodec encoder on the tablet instead of letting it choose.
video_source: What to capture: display (the screen) or camera.
